objective: Compare a selector fitted to observed label renamings and shortest selection on identical training-perfect programs across fresh tasks with different renaming behavior. Measure full operational search, ranking and certification costs to return exact programs with and without the frozen crossing.
status: Training-only renaming evidence selected 52/60 exact programs versus 27/60 shortest and 36/60 unconditional renaming. The matched twin is unidentifiable. With the same fitted selector the crossing returned 27/30 versus 26/30 at 37.15% more work per correct return before acquisition.
title: Choose a generalizing program and charge for checking it
